high_level_description: The image is a screenshot of a Twitter feed displaying a tweet from Raveena Tandon, a verified user (@TandonR...), posted 3 hours prior to the screenshot being taken. The tweet reads: "Unearthing the great historic past ... of Hindustan. What a precious archeological find." Below the tweet, there is an embedded newspaper clipping with the headline "Hindu idol unearthed in Zadibal." The article discusses the discovery of a stone sculpture of Shiva and Mata Rani at the Sham-sud-din Iraqi shrine in Zadibal. It mentions that the locals informed the police
